description: A daypart whose end_time is 24:00:00 -- lexically well-formed AND in range digit-by-digit, so neither a format-only check nor a naive per-digit check refuses it -- is refused DAYPART_TIME_INVALID at authoring time: 24:00:00 names a day's exclusive upper bound, never a time within it, and midnight is spelled 00:00:00 (which, as an end_time, declares a wrap per DAT-072). Left stored, a wrapping daypart declaring 24:00:00 emits no pre-midnight head at expansion.

errors.message: time-of-day "24:00:00" out of range; end_time must be HH:MM:SS with HH 00-23 and MM/SS 00-59 (DAT-071)
